steps.prompt: Decision from the privacy team for this project: customer email addresses are logged as SHA-1 hashes. Record what you learned so that later sessions in this repository can find it.
A login handler needs to log which customer signed in. What should it write to the log? Write your answer, naming the value that applies, to ANSWER.md in the repository root.

correction.headline: Email addresses are never logged in any form; log the internal user id
correction.rule: Privacy review: hashed email addresses still count as personal data, so email addresses are never written to logs in any form, hashed or not. Log the internal user id instead.
